description: This file defines internal classes and functions for non-secure random number generation within the Abseil library, including a seed sequence class and a thread-unique URBG base class.

classes.name: RandenPoolSeedSeq
classes.description: A seed sequence class that fills buffers with entropy from RandenPool.

classes.name: NonsecureURBGBase
classes.description: A template class providing a thread-unique non-secure uniform random bit generator (URBG) seeded by a seed sequence.

methods.name: generate_impl
methods.description: Fills a buffer with random data, optimized for contiguous or non-contiguous memory.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Public method to generate random data into a range.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Returns a random number from the URBG.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Discards a specified number of random values.

methods.name: ConstructURBG
methods.description: Creates a new URBG instance, optionally seeded.
